title: Fintech launch checklist
body: Define product, user segment, funds flow, operating countries, provider dependencies, specialist questions, budget, security controls and acceptance tests. Establish a written scope before commissioning work.

title: Banking readiness checklist
body: Collect entity details, ownership structure, business activities, customer types, operating countries, expected volumes, source of funds and compliance workflow. Confirm the provider's actual requirements directly.

title: Technology vendor evaluation
body: Compare capabilities, API documentation, integration effort, availability, security controls, data handling, commercial terms, portability and support. Test with a sandbox before procurement.

title: Market entry research worksheet
body: Record each market, intended activity, official business and regulatory sources, local specialist questions, estimated setup and operating costs, and unresolved evidence.

title: Project acceptance worksheet
body: Record deliverable, owner, due date, evidence, acceptance test, exception, client response and handover requirements.
